data.title: Fun with Units: Straws and Pencils!
data.description: Discover how measuring the same object with different units changes how many you need!

challenges.instruction: Look at this straw! If you measure it with tiny beads versus big paper clips, which unit would you need more of?
challenges.hint: Think about the size of the units. Smaller units mean you need more of them to cover the same length!
challenges.narration: Let's look at this straw! Try measuring it with two different units to see which one you need more of.

challenges.instruction: Examine this paintbrush. Do you need more small erasers or large blocks to measure its length?
challenges.hint: Remember, tiny pieces fit many times, while big pieces fit only a few times!
challenges.narration: Here is a paintbrush! Let's find out which measuring unit takes a greater number to reach the end.

challenges.instruction: Take a look at this ribbon. Which unit do you need more of to span the whole length?
challenges.hint: Compare the size of the first unit to the second unit. Which one is tinier?
challenges.narration: Time for the ribbon! Look closely at the units and decide which one you need more of.
